summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting the voting results of its Annual General and Special Meeting held on June 16, 2026. All matters put forward—election of nine directors, appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditors, and an advisory say-on-pay resolution—were approved by shareholders. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring was announced. This filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer under the Exchange Act, merely satisfying continuous disclosure obligations. As such, this constitutes a standard current report with no special-situation implications.
